evidence: We used tris(dimethylaminocyclopentadienyl)-zirconium (ZyALD), tertbutyliminotris(diethylamino)tantalum (TBTDET) and tetrakis(dimethylamino)germanium (TDMAGe) as zirconium, tantalum and germanium precursors, respectively. Argon purge steps are skipped to remove transition times and a constant flow of Ar and O 2 is flowed into the reactor.
